newsitem.title: NORWAY: Phillips hopes for Ekofisk restart around 1100 gmt.
newsitem.headline: Phillips hopes for Ekofisk restart around 1100 gmt.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum said on Tuesday it hoped to restart oil production at the North Sea Ekofisk field in a few hours.

"We started building up pressure at 2 a.m. (0100gmt), but then there was a leak in the system so we had to start all over again," Phillips spokesman Sander Bull-Gjertsen said. "We now hope to resume production at around noon (1100gmt)."

The 350,000 barrel per day development was shut in at 0400 GMT last Tuesday after a gas leak was detected in an oil pipeline. Restart of production had been planned for the weekend but was delayed because of problems fitting new parts into the pipeline.
Output from third party fields -- British Petroleum's Gyda and Ula and Amoco's Valhall and Hod -- and the Statpipe gas line was uninterupted by the unscheduled shutdown.
